newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Aetna unit to buy AMP Hong Kong life book.
newsitem.headline: Aetna unit to buy AMP Hong Kong life book.

text.p: East Asia Aetna Insurance Group said on Tuesday it was buying the entire Hong Kong life insurance portfolio of Australia's AMP Society.
The transfer is subject to the sanction of the Hong Kong Supreme Court and ratification is expected in the New Year, East Asia Aetna said in a statement.
No financial details were disclosed, but East Asia Aetna, a unit of Aetna Inc said it expected sales to grow 20 per cent as a result.
A spokeswoman for East Asia Aetna said the deal recognised that the company was seeking to expand its domestic Hong Kong business while AMP was seeking to withdraw from the local market.

Roger Steel, general manager of AMP's Hong Kong operations was quoted in the East Asia Aetna statement as saying AMP "was late into the very competitive Hong Kong insurance market" and its progress had been hampered as a result.
The East Asia Aetna statement said AMP was committed to the region but was focusing attention on China. AMP has clients in Malaysia, Hong Kong and Indonesia, said the statement.
